profile.headline: Senior Software Developer @ Qualcomm | Architecting Microservices, Optimizing Data Processing
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Developer at Qualcomm, I architect microservices and manage containerized deployments to ensure high availability. I contribute to optimizing data processing systems to enhance overall performance and lead efforts to modernize legacy systems into scalable, cloud-native architectures. I also mentor junior developers, sharing best practices in coding, system design, and deployment.  

With a Master of Science in Computer Science from California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo, my academic foundation complements my professional experience in delivering robust, efficient solutions. My career has been marked by an emphasis on leveraging TypeScript, React.js, and RDBMS to build impactful software systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
● Architected microservices and managed containerized deployments for high availability
● Optimized data processing to increase overall system performance
● Led legacy modernization efforts to deliver scalable, cloud-native architecture
● Mentor junior developers on coding standards, system design, and deployment best practices
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Java · C# · Kubernetes · TypeScript · React.js · RDBMS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Optimized ORM database queries, reducing response times from minutes to seconds
● Designed a application integration layer to unify data from three disparate systems
● Implemented security enhancements across the platform, resolving 40+ vulnerability reports
● Contributed to front-end development using React, improving user interface load time by 18%

positions.title: Software Engineer IT
positions.description:
● Integrated a single MongoDB database into front and back-end services to load user-specific configurations
● Componentized a TypeScript React front-end to improve UI consistency and maintainability
● Developed and maintained critical services for high-volume satellite communication systems
● Translated a vanilla JavaScript front-end into Next JS server-side components to improve UI speeds
● Implemented a micro-service that notifies Viasat teams of internal service interruptions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed real restate bid history and market insights software for lenders and appraisers 
● Created API endpoints that interface with Mongo and SQL database sources
● Updated legacy account authorization to use OpenID/OAuth with Okta
● Handled version control with git branching and pull requests
● Contributed in Agile teams using Atlassian products, Jira and Confluence

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
● Developed real restate bid history and market insights software for lenders and appraisers 
● Refactored Angular components into React components
● Handled version control with git branching and pull requests
● Contributed in Agile teams using Atlassian products, Jira and Confluence

testScores.name: Business Critical Thinking Skills Test
testScores.description: The Business Critical Thinking Skills Test (BCTST) provides an objective measure of the core reasoning skills needed for reflective decision making and problem solving in business and workplace settings. The BCTST was developed and field tested to present problems using business-relevant topics and, in some cases, with data presented in images and diagrams.
